site.method: imagery re-center: wide 2026-07 chip revealed graded polygon ~2.5 km SSW of Hagansport community; tight chip confirms footprint with road grid and substation pad. Corroborated by IA Exhibit C POI (Hagansport Switch, Franklin County, ~31 mi NE Sulphur Springs).
site.derivation_chain: 1) IA Exhibit C (PUCT 35077-2101, Oncor x Lupinus Solar 2 LLC) — text only, no map: POI = 'Hagansport Switch in TSP's 138 kV, ~31 miles NE of Sulphur Springs, Franklin County'. 2) Nominatim geocode of the Hagansport community: 33.3415,-95.2494 (TX-37/FM-71 junction) — POI-community anchor, LOW confidence, explicitly not the array. 3) Wide 2026-07 Sentinel-2 chip around that anchor revealed a graded polygon ~2.5 km SSW of Hagansport with road grid + substation pad; site re-centered onto the observed footprint = 33.305,-95.275 (medium-high). Same pattern as Moccasin: no parcel map exists in any filing, so the visible construction footprint is the boundary evidence.

land_tenure.evidence: Franklin CAD returns 0 parcels under Lupinus Solar 2 or Sunraycer — consistent with leased farmland remaining on tax roll under original landowner names. No abatement application found to confirm tenure type directly.

evidence: 2025-12 Sentinel-2 chip (imagery/key/s2_2025-12_pre.png) shows undisturbed winter farmland across the site footprint — no clearing or grading

2026-07 Sentinel-2 wide chip (imagery/s2_2026-07-10.png) shows large multi-polygon graded footprint in SW quadrant; tight re-centered chip (imagery/s2_2026-07-10_tight.png) confirms road grid, cleared soil, and prominent white pad (substation/switchyard) — classic early-stage solar site preparation

PV-Tech 2026-03-24 article (sources/2026-07-19_pvtech_sunraycer-google-lupinus-ppas.html): 'Earlier in March 2026, Sunraycer broke ground on three Texas solar-plus-storage projects, including the two-phase Lupinus project' — confirms construction began ~March 2026

SHARED-CAMPUS SERIES (fetched 2026-07-21, centered 33.317,-95.283, 8km frames): one contiguous Sunraycer campus hosts Lupinus Solar 1+2 (and their paired Storage 1+2 queue positions) at the Hagansport Switch. 2024-07/2025-07: undisturbed; 2026-01: pre-groundbreaking baseline; 2026-04 (one month after the 2026-03-17 groundbreaking PR): clearing underway in the NW section + a large bright cleared block SE with access roads; 2026-07-15: one contiguous ~4km earthworks operation — block outlines forming NW, laydown/pads SE. No racking/panels yet at 10m/px. The two solar INRs cannot be separated visually until array blocks are energized — do not attribute sub-areas to 1 vs 2 without a plot plan.

tax_incentives.ch313_jeti: structural negative — 2024 queue entry postdates Ch.313's 2022-12-31 sunset; no JETI application (checked by INR + 'Lupinus'/'Sunraycer').
ch312: negative across all three datasets (live 1,398 + post-abatement reports 888 + Wayback-recovered 170) by INR, SPV name, developer name, AND county — Franklin County has ZERO rows in the registry (non-reporting county), so this is a WEAK negative on registry grounds alone. HOWEVER, context makes a real abatement genuinely unlikely: Franklin County attempted a 180-day commercial-solar MORATORIUM in 2023 (rescinded after the county attorney warned it was unenforceable; interim AG Colmenero then ruled counties lack authority to ban solar — ksstradio.com 2023-08). A county hostile enough to attempt a moratorium was not granting Ch.312 abatements; the project proceeded without one.
tax_incentives.commissioners_minutes: VERIFIED NEGATIVE for online records (2026-07-21): Franklin County's commissioners-court page (co.franklin.tx.us, ezTask) publishes NO meeting minutes or agendas at all -- a minutes.py harvest returned only 3 procedural documents (rules of procedure 2018, public-participation form, a 2021 transfer-station item). Any abatement/road-use votes for this project exist only in the paper minute books at the county clerk -- reachable via TPIA/open-records request, not online. Given the county's 2023 anti-solar moratorium attempt, the minutes would likely document opposition rather than incentives.
